digest.component_or_area: GitHub Actions build-and-test workflow, macOS pytest infrastructure
propositions: macOS pytest runtime is dominated by filesystem I/O from thousands of small Git repository writes; a measured APFS RAM disk can provide 2x+ speedup per OSS precedent (Apple Git, Aeron).

The current macOS CI cell must create an ephemeral 2 GiB APFS RAM disk before pytest, route default and integration selectors to separate basetemps on that mount, and always detach the exact device after tests complete.
All Ubuntu CI cells must retain runner.temp without modification; the RAM disk creation and sizing must be macOS-only with at least 50% headroom and remain below 40% of detected physical memory.

Static workflow contract tests must verify macOS-only RAM disk creation, unchanged pytest selectors/markers/xdist counts/coverage behavior, distinct default/integration basetemps, and unconditional cleanup of the exact device via always() block.

The implementation is retained only if the full Gerrit Verify matrix is green, macOS job wall time improves beyond observed recent-run variation versus the documented control (20m09s default+integration), and Ubuntu times remain within their observed range.
